description: This file defines an interface for creating a CWMP ACS connection object in the CCSP protocol implementation. It primarily contains a factory method `CcspCwmpCreateAcsConnection` that creates and returns a new ACS connection object via `CcspCwmpAcscoCreate`.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CcspCwmpCreateAcsConnection(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a new ACS connection object handle using the internal `CcspCwmpAcscoCreate` function.
